name: Business Valuation (Discounted Cash Flow) Calculator
meta_title: DCF Calculator: Business Valuation by Discounted Cash Flow
meta_description: Value a business with a discounted cash flow model: project free cash flow, add a Gordon growth or exit multiple terminal value, and get equity value per share.
subtitle: Estimate what a business is worth by projecting its free cash flow, discounting it to today and adding a terminal value, then converting enterprise value to equity value and value per share.

Discounted cash flow by year

Each year's free cash flow multiplied by its discount factor gives its value today. Their sum plus the discounted terminal value is the enterprise value.
